scope: Poaceae taxonomy only; existing installed tridentopsis-buckleyana. No species card, media, genus/family, installation, range, Pages or schedule changes.

scientific_decisions.reason: POWO/WCVP 2026 accepts this species at species rank in Poaceae; canonical name and author match.
1894 basionym is a homotypic synonym, not a separate learner concept.
1903 homotypic combination maps to existing accepted Tridentopsis learner; older FNA and ITIS use Tridens.
1933 homotypic combination belongs to the same type and accepted species.

scientific_decisions.source_name: (Vasey ex L.H.Dewey) P.M.Peterson & Romasch. vs (L.H.Dewey) P.M.Peterson & Romasch.
scientific_decisions.accepted_target: SAME ACCEPTED NAME, OPTIONAL EX AUTHOR
scientific_decisions.reason: The 2016 validating combination explicitly uses the expanded 'Vasey ex L.H.Dewey' basionym author; POWO/IPNI use the shorter L.H.Dewey form. Botanical author-citation rules permit omission of the author before 'ex'. Do not treat this as a distinct taxon or unresolved orthographic conflict.

scientific_decisions.source_name: 2016 original taxonomic treatment of Tridentopsis buckleyana
scientific_decisions.reason: Peterson et al. (2016), Taxon 65:1278, give Buckley s.n. (Texas, 1883), holotype US No. 81808 and isotype NY 00431683. This anchors the nomenclatural concept but does not verify learner photo specimens.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Tridentopsis buckleyana vs Tridentopsis mutica and Tridentopsis elongata
scientific_decisions.reason: Current POWO genus lists all three separately; do not merge Buckley's tridens with T. mutica or T. elongata based on older broad Tridens placement.
Installed canonical identity matches accepted species; keep historical names as aliases and preserve original identity/range/photo review states.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Proposal to make Tridens buckleyanus the current canonical accepted name based solely on ITIS
scientific_decisions.reason: ITIS treats Tridens buckleyanus as accepted based on 2009/2010 sources, whereas current POWO/WCVP and the 2016 primary transfer accept Tridentopsis buckleyana. FAIL applies to proposed rename, not historical synonym.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Proposal to install separate cards for Sieglingia buckleyana, Tridens buckleyanus, Triodia buckleyana
scientific_decisions.reason: All three names are homotypic synonyms of one accepted species, not independent learner species.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Individual gallery photograph or field specimen assigned to Tridentopsis buckleyana
scientific_decisions.reason: Nomenclature, type citation and published descriptions cannot authenticate individual photos or observations; leave all existing photo/specimen identity holds.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Proposed hybrid parentage of a putative Tridentopsis buckleyana specimen
scientific_decisions.reason: No specimen-specific molecular, voucher or primary hybrid evidence was evaluated; do not infer hybrid ancestry from panicle appearance or genus membership.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Unvouchered historical 'Tridens' / 'Buckley's tridens' records without author, type or diagnostic context
scientific_decisions.reason: Historical broad-generic or vernacular labels alone cannot validate a particular plant's modern species identity; preserve source-level uncertainty pending voucher review.

primary_authority.citation: Peterson, Romaschenko & Herrera Arrieta (2016), Taxon 65(6):1278, doi:10.12705/656.4
primary_authority.scope: New combination, basionym and type; primary paper uses full Vasey ex L.H.Dewey citation.

authority_caution: The 'Vasey ex' expansion and abbreviated L.H.Dewey author citation are compatible under botanical nomenclatural practice; the ITIS Tridens genus placement is a historical alternative, not grounds for a second accepted learner.
